info.name: AI Image API
info.description: Local health checks and authentication requests. Signup and login need the migrated Neon database.

variable.description: Local backend URL. Change this if the server uses another host or port.
Automatically set to the most recently uploaded image or first image in List images. You can also set it manually.

request.description: Returns a plain-text message.
Lightweight liveness endpoint; does not require Neon or Redis.
Returns 200 when Neon and Redis are available, or 503 when one is unavailable.

exec: pm.test('Readiness reports a known dependency state', () => pm.expect([200, 503]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Plans
item.description: List plans publicly. Current plan/change requests require Sign in. Free has 5 monthly credits per mode; Pro has 20 per mode; Max is Coming Soon.

request.description: Shows monthly per-mode quotas. Pro pricing is not set yet; Max is unavailable and marked Coming Soon.

exec: pm.test('Plans are ordered Free, Pro, Max', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.plans.map((plan) => plan.slug)).to.eql(['free', 'pro', 'max']));

pm.test('Free quota is five per mode', () => { const plans = pm.response.json().data.plans; const free = plans.find((plan) => plan.slug === 'free'); pm.expect(free.creditsPerMode).to.eql({ textToImage: 5, imageToImage: 5, enhanceImage: 5 }); });

pm.test('Image upload quotas differ by plan', () => { const plans = pm.response.json().data.plans; const free = plans.find((plan) => plan.slug === 'free'); const pro = plans.find((plan) => plan.slug === 'pro'); pm.expect(free.imageUploads).to.eql({ monthlyLimit: 10, storageLimitBytes: 104857600, storageLimitMegabytes: 100 }); pm.expect(pro.imageUploads).to.eql({ monthlyLimit: 50, storageLimitBytes: 524288000, storageLimitMegabytes: 500 }); });

pm.test('Pro quota is twenty per mode', () => { const plans = pm.response.json().data.plans; const pro = plans.find((plan) => plan.slug === 'pro'); pm.expect(pro.creditsPerMode).to.eql({ textToImage: 20, imageToImage: 20, enhanceImage: 20 }); });

pm.test('Max is marked Coming Soon', () => { const plans = pm.response.json().data.plans; const max = plans.find((plan) => plan.slug === 'max'); pm.expect(max.comingSoon).to.eql(true); pm.expect(max.available).to.eql(false); });

request.description: Requires sign-in. Shows the active plan and any scheduled cancellation.

Requires sign-in. Use planSlug 'free' to request a downgrade; active Pro stays until its current period ends. Pro activation requires checkout and cannot be completed yet. Max is Coming Soon. An administrator can grant complimentary Pro access.

exec: pm.test('Free plan selection succeeds or is already active', () => pm.expect([200]).to.include(pm.response.code));

item.name: Auth
item.description: Run in order: Create account, Verify email, Sign in, Current user. Create account emails an OTP; Verify email creates the account after validation.

request.description: Replace your-email@gmail.com with an inbox you can access. Only Gmail/Googlemail, Outlook/Hotmail/Live/MSN, and listed Yahoo domains are accepted; known disposable domains are blocked. Signup OTP requests are rate-limited.

exec: pm.test('Signup stores pending details and sends verification OTP', () => pm.response.to.have.status(202));

request.description: Paste the 6-digit code sent after Create account. A valid code verifies the email and creates the account.

exec: pm.test('Email verification creates the account', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('Created account is verified and has no password hash', () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.data.user.emailVerified).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.data.user).not.to.have.property('passwordHash'); });

request.description: Run after Verify email creates the account. Postman stores the 15-minute access cookie and 30-day refresh cookie automatically.
Run after Sign in. Postman sends the stored access-token cookie automatically.

exec: pm.test('Current user has an allowed provider address', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.email).to.match(/@(gmail|googlemail|outlook|hotmail|live|msn|yahoo|ymail|rocketmail)\./i));

request.description: Uses the HttpOnly refresh cookie and rotates both cookies. Run this when the 15-minute access token expires; do not send the refresh token in the body.

exec: pm.test('Refreshed session returns a verified user', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.emailVerified).to.eql(true));

request.description: Revokes this refresh-token session and clears both auth cookies.

item.name: Credits
item.description: Run after Sign in. Displays this user's current UTC-month usage and recent ledger activity.

request.description: Requires login. Shows remaining monthly credits separately for Text-to-Image, Image-to-Image, and Enhance Image.

exec: pm.test('All three generation modes have separate quotas', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(pm.response.json().data.credits.modes)).to.eql(['textToImage', 'imageToImage', 'enhanceImage']));

request.description: Requires login. Shows the latest 50 generation charges and refunds.

item.name: Images
item.description: Image upload and library endpoints. Sign in first. Free: 10 uploads/month and 100 MB active storage. Pro: 50 uploads/month and 500 MB active storage. Each upload is capped at 10 MB, 4096 x 4096 pixels, and 16 megapixels. Deleting frees storage, not monthly upload count.

request.description: Choose a local image in the image form-data field. Postman sets multipart Content-Type automatically. Requires sign-in and Cloudinary credentials. Saves the returned image ID to the imageId collection variable.

exec: pm.test('Uploaded image has metadata but no Cloudinary public ID', () => { const image = pm.response.json().data.image; pm.expect(image.url).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(image.format).to.be.oneOf(['jpeg', 'png', 'webp']); pm.expect(image.width).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(image.height).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(image).not.to.have.property('publicId'); });
if (pm.response.code === 201) { const image = pm.response.json().data.image; pm.collectionVariables.set('imageId', image.id); console.log('Saved imageId:', image.id); }

request.description: Lists only the signed-in user's images. Pagination limit is at most 50.

exec: pm.test('Image library reports quota usage', () => { const usage = pm.response.json().data.uploadUsage; pm.expect(usage.monthlyUploads).to.have.keys('used', 'limit', 'remaining'); pm.expect(usage.storage).to.have.keys('usedBytes', 'limitBytes', 'remainingBytes'); });

if (pm.response.code === 200) { const images = pm.response.json().data.images; if (images.length > 0) { pm.collectionVariables.set('imageId', images[0].id); console.log('Saved first imageId:', images[0].id); } else { pm.collectionVariables.unset('imageId'); console.log('No images found; imageId cleared.'); } }

request.description: Uses imageId from the most recent successful Upload image or the first item in List images. You can also edit the imageId collection variable. Other users' images return 404.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('imageId')) { throw new Error('imageId is empty. Run Upload image or List images first, or set the imageId collection variable.'); }

request.description: Uses imageId from the most recent successful Upload image or the first item in List images. You can also edit the imageId collection variable. Deletes the Cloudinary object and database asset.

exec: if (!pm.collectionVariables.get('imageId')) { throw new Error('imageId is empty. Run Upload image or List images first, or set the imageId collection variable.'); }

item.name: Admin
item.description: Admin-only Pro access management. Sign in using the regular Auth folder first with an ADMIN account. A trusted database operator must assign the ADMIN role; public promotion is unavailable.

request.description: Grant the verified account 30 days of Pro access. durationDays must be 1-365. If they already have an active manual grant, the new duration extends it. Requires an ADMIN account.

exec: pm.test('Grant response identifies Pro and expiry', () => { const grant = pm.response.json().data.grant; pm.expect(grant.plan.slug).to.eql('pro'); pm.expect(grant.expiresAt).to.be.a('string'); });

request.description: Lists the latest 100 manual grants with recipient, admin, and expiry details. Requires an ADMIN account.

item.name: Account settings
item.description: Run after Sign in. Profile/password/delete need the login cookie; reset codes come by email or from the development terminal.

request.description: Paste the 6-digit one-time reset code from the email or development terminal into otp before running. It expires in 30 minutes. The new password must be at least 8 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol.

Requires a signed-in user. newPassword and confirmPassword must match; the new password must be at least 8 characters and include uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol. Changing the password revokes refresh sessions and clears this browser's auth cookies.

Requires a signed-in user. Use an unused Gmail, Outlook, or Yahoo address; known disposable domains are blocked and email changes are rate-limited. emailVerified stays false until the new address is verified.

exec: pm.test('Changed email is unverified until confirmed', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.user.emailVerified).to.eql(false));
pm.test('Response confirms code delivery', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('Verification code sent'));

request.description: Run after Update profile. Paste the 6-digit code sent to the new email address.
Permanently deletes the signed-in account and its related records. Update the password in the body to the account's current password before running.
